title: Review verdict (exeris-sdk)
description: The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's reviewing roles and its surfaces. The three-state `decision` and the `checks_run` contract are the base's; only the vocabulary is local. `scope_class` is finer than the four classes ADR-085 §E.16 fixes for a pull-request body, because a review answers which surface broke and a body answers how far the change reaches.

agent.description: One role, because one role emits. `exeris-sdk-architect` is the only profile naming this schema in `output` and the only one the CI review runs as. Widening the enum ahead of a second emitter would let a verdict validate under a role that has never produced one.
